search_scope.eligibility_rule: A reusable measured experiment or in-use fill must expose station/controller and dispenser/nozzle plus vehicle/receptacle channels on one common time base, with units, initial conditions, tank capacity, protocol metadata and reuse terms.

findings.source: H2-Stations API and European Hydrogen Observatory
findings.role: public station registry, layout and availability/usage/storage-status context
findings.reason: The published interfaces provide station metadata and status streams, not synchronized dispenser/controller, vehicle-side pressure/temperature and transferred-mass/flow logger rows.

findings.source: Cal State LA HRFF back-to-back and multi-year operation studies
findings.role: independent real-station operating-range and data-custodian lead
findings.reason: The public articles describe one-year or multi-year station logs and vehicle/fueling variables, but the accessible records do not provide reusable synchronized event rows, channel dictionary, calibration metadata and reuse terms.

findings.role: independent single-event protocol and operating-range context
findings.reason: The public presentation contains plotted station, hose, receptacle, manifold and tank signals plus aggregate fill metrics, but no row-level archive or reuse-cleared channel package.

findings.source: DOE/OSTI Cal State LA data-program records
findings.reason: The records corroborate a real station, data-acquisition system and fueling experiments, but the public artifacts do not contain a rights-cleared synchronized station-to-vehicle raw export.

decision.claim_boundary: This is a data-availability audit. It does not prove that restricted, proprietary or unpublished traces do not exist, and it does not support a station-to-vehicle accuracy, vehicle-controller or field-safety validation claim.
decision.reentry_condition: A custodian supplies at least three rights-cleared common-clock events with station/controller, dispenser/nozzle and vehicle/receptacle channels, units, initial conditions, tank capacity and protocol metadata; freeze the scoring protocol before numerical outcome access.
